nodes.label: P033-001: Scope and Research Decisions
nodes.description: 1) сопоставить title/ID/objective; 2) записать official/repo/proposed/unknown; 3) выбрать Tier и resource assumptions; 4) принять/отложить D011–D020 с impact; 5) запретить final-outcome tuning.

nodes.label: P033-002: Environment and CI Portability
nodes.description: 1) сохранить baseline versions; 2) добавить Windows/Ubuntu matrix, format+lock validation и timeout; 3) убрать network dependence default suite; 4) описать Temp/cache workaround; 5) проверить clean install в новой разрешённой папке без удаления текущей .venv.

nodes.label: P033-003: Five Pilot Source Cards
nodes.description: original terms/citation review; snapshot metadata; verify target/positive/features; review cohorts and unavailable predictors; register family/duplicate policy; record unresolved access.

nodes.label: P033-006: Strict Result Admission
nodes.description: define `validate_benchmark_result(result, expected_protocol)` PROPOSED; verify fields/finite/ranges/actual completed folds and params; `select_research_results(paths)` returns accepted+rejected manifest; separate smoke; enforce source/protocol identity and duplicate policy.

nodes.label: P033-007: General-Domain Predictor Fence
nodes.description: add versioned `feature_schema`/explicit allowlist; reject unknown score-like predictors; reject clinical rows on general training/evaluation path; permit clinical only separate transfer evaluation; tests injecting both contamination types.

nodes.label: P033-011: Provenance and Recovery
nodes.source_location: P033-011 — Provenance, atomic writes and recovery
nodes.description: `collect_run_metadata` PROPOSED (git/env/OS/CPU/RAM/threads/checksums/config/candidates/splits); `write_result_atomic`; compatible identity-aware resume per outer unit; save index incrementally; preserve failed attempts; fix custom summary dirs/batch exit semantics.

nodes.label: P033-014: General Dataset Discovery
nodes.description: verify candidate metadata/source mappings; exclude clinical/duplicates/unsupported tasks prospectively; plot coverage from metadata; extend candidates until target independent families plausible; log rejected sources before scores.

nodes.label: P033-018: Expanded Full Production
nodes.description: smoke new sources first; schedule compatible full by cost bands; persist checkpoints; compare attempted vs expected counts; stop new jobs at budget limit without shortening trials; no outcome-based removals.

nodes.label: P033-023: Freeze Meta Evaluation
nodes.source_location: P033-023 — Freeze meta evaluation and optional nested selection
nodes.description: LOGO primary; assign any lockbox groups; fix Ridge and primary paired regret metric; predefine sensitivity/secondary comparisons; if tuning enabled implement grouped inner splits/default for tiny n; record immutable manifest timestamp/hash.

nodes.label: P033-025: Saved-Model Unseen Inference
nodes.source_location: P033-025 — Export and true unseen-dataset inference
nodes.description: fit general-only final model; `save_recommender/load_recommender` PROPOSED with trusted local artifacts and version/schema hashes; `characterize_for_recommendation` same75% sampling contract; `p033 recommend` PROPOSED labelled CSV→gap/pipeline/fallback JSON; OOD/range check and finite validation.

nodes.label: P033-031: Zero-Shot Clinical Evaluation
nodes.description: save predictions before benchmark labels; model checksum unchanged; run registered paired clinical benchmark; compute regret/fixed baselines; group-level uncertainty appropriate to tiny n; summarize shift.

nodes.label: P033-032: Reproducibility Packaging
nodes.description: ignore raw datasets/token/model blobs/external clones; explicit tracked summary allowlist; archive manifests; clean clone locked setup; offline tests+one public smoke; regenerate saved-result metrics; capture exact commands and checksums; update README/ARCHITECTURE/NEXT_STEPS/data dictionary.

nodes.label: P033-037: Final Submission Review
nodes.description: populate70 requirement evidence statuses; verify paths/links/commands; check Git status/artifact allowlist; source licenses/privacy; report-slide consistency; required university package checklist; tag/export proposal only under authorized workflow, no auto push.

nodes.label: P033-004: Preprocessor edge/leakage verification
nodes.description: add unknown/all-missing/constants/bool fixtures; spy training imputer/scaler fit; encoded-width arithmetic/boundaries; direct-transform bypass review; fixes only for failing contract, no redesign.

nodes.label: P033-005: Protocol and candidate parity
nodes.description: check full/smoke constants; test20 unique candidates+baseline+seed; controlled scores test tie; spy shared split IDs; add parity check rather than loading all TOML unnecessarily.

nodes.label: P033-008: Split/duplicate admission gates
nodes.description: reject unsupported strategies early; validate both classes in actual train/validation/test; persist duplicate review decision; test rare classes/too-small test; no silent dedup or K reduction.

nodes.label: P033-009: Real pilot fetch/audit
nodes.description: fetch all; retain metadata/local checksum; audit; compare expected roles/missingness/labels; manually resolve duplicate/signature decisions before benchmarking.

nodes.label: P033-010: Five real smoke runs
nodes.description: credit-g first; inspect trial/warnings/scores; remaining4 sequentially; review JSON; verify development namespace and research_valid=false; record failure tickets.

nodes.label: P033-012: First full and cost calibration
nodes.source_location: P033-012 — First full and cost calibration
nodes.description: record host budget; run exact full CLI once; verify360+6 completeness; read timing/peakRSS; estimate remaining n×encoded_width bands and scheduling cap; retain scientific failure if any.

nodes.label: P033-013: Upstream isolated partial reproduction
nodes.description: read article/source; inspect requirements/model helpers; create separate clone/env; disable submission in logged local config/adapter and prevent helper default run; verify no-submit path handles metrics; audit MBGM; one local CatBoost/default/minimalistic attempt; capture true errors; classify reproduced/partial/blocked.

nodes.label: P033-015: Register and validate expansion batches
nodes.source_location: P033-015 — Register and validate expansion batches
nodes.description: pin IDs/version/checksum/roles/labels/family; validate source fixtures; fetch/audit; class/split/memory preflight; update inventory/exclusion ledger.

nodes.label: P033-016: Versioned compact and extended meta-features
nodes.source_location: P033-016 — Versioned compact and extended meta-features
nodes.description: implement numeric/categorical/correlation helpers in features.py; preserve v1; compute v2 NA/defined-count indicators; deterministic sample caps; expected fixture arithmetic; extraction cost check; freeze primary compact schema before production labels inspection.

nodes.label: P033-017: Full pilot completion
nodes.description: reuse validated identical runs; backfill descriptors from same split IDs if safe; full remaining sources; validator/index; record exclusions/resources.

nodes.label: P033-019: Failure reconciliation and exclusion analysis
nodes.source_location: P033-019 — Failure reconciliation and exclusion analysis
nodes.description: classify scientific/protocol vs infra failures; rerun only identical corrected infra cases with attempt lineage; keep initial failure; quantify exclusion by n,p,cardinality/domain; assess selection bias.

nodes.label: P033-020: Build primary meta-dataset
nodes.description: strict admission; source/cohort dedup; mean aggregation; allowlist; general-only table; manifest/exclusion report; frozen train/eval snapshot.

nodes.label: P033-021: Meta preprocessing
nodes.description: `make_meta_preprocessor` PROPOSED: median+indicators, scaling for Ridge only; all-missing column rule deterministic; fit within meta-train; schema validation before transform.

nodes.label: P033-022: Baselines and four recommenders
nodes.description: preserve existing Dummy/Ridge/tree/RF; add explicit constant strategies and best-fixed-from-training; test margin; compare default outputs without tuning final outcomes; record model configs.

nodes.label: P033-024: Full held-out metrics and CLI artifacts
nodes.source_location: P033-024 — Full held-out metrics and CLI artifacts
nodes.description: `evaluate_recommender` add MAE/balanced winner accuracy/near-ties, explicit invalid selected label; verify manual regret fixture; OOF predictions exactly once; separate per-model output dirs and summary mkdir; record all baseline losses.

nodes.label: P033-026: Statistical uncertainty
nodes.description: `bootstrap_regret_difference` PROPOSED with family clusters/seed; report percentile95% CI; repeated-seed variability descriptive; specify conditional nature; secondary multiplicity policy.

nodes.label: P033-027: Feature interpretation and ablation
nodes.description: coefficient stability; fold-safe permutation where feasible; v1/compact/full and group-drop ablations; repeat grouped evaluation with fixed settings; annotate correlations/uncertainty.

nodes.label: P033-028: Error, sensitivity and negative-result analysis
nodes.source_location: P033-028 — Error, sensitivity and negative-result analysis
nodes.description: .0/.005/.01/.02 margins; worst-regret cases; domain/family/synthetic sensitivity; compare admitted/excluded; review OOD and missingness; write evidence-supported RQ drafts including failures.

nodes.label: P033-029: Clinical source admission
nodes.description: permissions/attribution, prediction time/endpoint, patient/time availability, ID/post-outcome exclusions, class/missingness audit; choose3–5 feasible independent cohorts for Tier B, or2–3 Tier A; avoid WDBC as pristine holdout due demo exposure.

nodes.label: P033-030: Clinical loaders and grouped/temporal engine
nodes.source_location: P033-030 — Clinical loaders and grouped/temporal engine
nodes.description: clinical adapter→LoadedDataset-compatible contract with group/time outside predictors; `make_clinical_splits` PROPOSED handles registered grouped/forward split; group both inner/outer; validate class coverage and temporal ordering; versionD017; never invent timestamp from follow-up duration.

nodes.label: P033-033: Figures and scientific tables
nodes.description: implement `load_validated_summaries`, `make_benchmark_table`, `make_recommender_table`, `make_figures` PROPOSED in existing reporting.py; choose/pin minimal plotting dependency if needed; no estimator fitting; axes/units/counts/uncertainty provenance; inspect exported figures.

nodes.label: P033-034: Academic report
nodes.description: написать21 раздел по final deliverables; every claim→artifact/citation; scope/leakage/power limitations; reconcile abstract/title/figures; technical and language review; export preferred format only after rubric confirmed.

nodes.label: P033-035: Presentation
nodes.description: build12 slides from final deliverables outline; annotate sample/family counts; separate reproduction vs original contribution; rehearse within later confirmed time; check readable plots.

nodes.label: P033-036: Offline technical demo
nodes.description: demonstrate registry/audit→features→saved model→gap/choice/fallback→OOF/regret figure; disclose labelled sample and scope; prepared offline caches; no full HPO live.

nodes.label: P033-038: Optional broader families/preprocessing
nodes.description: add ≥2 distinct estimators per family (e.g. HistGBDT+CatBoost/XGBoost; MLP+ResNet/FT-Transformer/MLP-PLR), pin dependencies/env; per-model pilot; family selection **inside inner loop**; cost-balanced secondary design; preprocessing regimes separate experiments; no post-outer-score best-of-family.
